mob_forceload.msg.summoned: Summoned and marked %s (keeping %s chunks force-loaded around it).
mob_forceload.msg.not_whitelisted: %s is not in the whitelist and was not marked. Add its ID to mobWhitelist in config/mob_forceload-common.toml.
mob_forceload.msg.list.empty: No entity is marked right now.
mob_forceload.msg.info: Force-load radius: %s chunks; keep simulation distance: %s; marked entities: %s.
mob_forceload.msg.forceload.added: Added region force-load: blocks X %s..%s, Z %s..%s (chunks X %s..%s, Z %s..%s). Only the %s centre chunks get tickets; each ticket radiates over its own 5x5, together covering %s chunks. Registering tickets does not generate terrain on the spot - the radiation area is loaded by the game in the background. About %s tickets per tick, roughly %s seconds to queue them, without freezing the server.
mob_forceload.msg.forceload.duplicate: That region is already force-loaded: blocks X %s..%s, Z %s..%s (chunks X %s..%s, Z %s..%s).
mob_forceload.msg.forceload.too_large: Region too large: at most %s centre chunks per command, this one needs %s. Shrink it and try again.
mob_forceload.msg.forceload.limit: Region force-load rejected: this command plans %s chunks; with %s already force-loaded the total would be %s, over the configured limit of %s. Shrink the region, or raise maxForceLoadedChunks in config/mob_forceload-common.toml (default 1000).
mob_forceload.msg.forceload.huge: Heads-up: this keeps %s chunks force-loaded for good. Once applied, the server has to tick all of them every tick, which costs a lot of CPU over time. If you only want to stop mobs from being unloaded, the region does not need to be this big.
mob_forceload.msg.forceload.removed: Removed %s force-loaded region(s); those chunks are no longer force-loaded.
mob_forceload.msg.forceload.none: No force-loaded region has been added with /mfforceload add.
